description: Curated conditional interactions based on code. Source-reviewed is NOT production-browser verified. Only mark live-verified after authorized browser testing.

dialogs.title: Verify packed item quantity
dialogs.visibleWhen: Signed-in operator, manager, or admin; selected production job with order lines

fields.name: Count
fields.meaning: Number of physical units checked for the specific job item. Must be an integer between zero and ordered quantity.

fields.name: Bag / pack note
fields.meaning: Optional player, bag, box or packing instruction; not a stock reservation.

dialogs.confirmation: Confirm actual count for this exact job item
dialogs.result: Appends verified quantity event; does not deduct stock, change invoice, or close the job
errors: Job or item has been canceled
dialogs.trainingScenario: Fictional 14-hoodie group order; review sizes then practice how to verify exact packed counts without saving to real jobs

dialogs.title: Record actual in-person pickup
dialogs.visibleWhen: Eligible production job; latest QC passed; all active lines packed; operator+ role

fields.name: Recipient full name
fields.meaning: The actual person physically collecting the packages; serves as typed-name acknowledgment.

fields.name: Recipient relationship / role
fields.meaning: Coach, parent, or client representative, when relevant.

fields.name: Number of packages handed over
fields.meaning: Physical packages transferred, not garment units.

fields.name: Pickup notes
fields.meaning: Location, exception, or handoff detail.

fields.name: Consent checkbox
fields.meaning: Confirms recipient acknowledges receipt.

dialogs.confirmation: Recipient is present and actually collecting the number of packages
dialogs.result: Records an immutable receipt and a fulfillment event; does not change source job status
errors: Newest QC is missing or failed
dialogs.trainingScenario: Practice with fictional team coach. Never generate a real pickup signature during training.

dialogs.title: Confirm exact customer-approved artwork revision
dialogs.visibleWhen: Artwork handoff is explicitly linked to selected job; operator+ role

fields.name: Approved artwork handoff
fields.meaning: A linked file/review record, not necessarily proof of customer approval.

fields.name: Revision or version number
fields.meaning: Specific version approved for manufacturing.

fields.name: Customer approval reference
fields.meaning: Source message, proof ID or recorded decision.

fields.name: Production file name
fields.meaning: Actual output file used to manufacture.

fields.name: Production review note
fields.meaning: Supplementary production instructions.

dialogs.confirmation: Verify original customer approval and exact revision before producing
dialogs.result: Appends a revision review record; never fabricates customer approval
errors: Handoff not linked to this job
dialogs.trainingScenario: Choose the correct approved fictional v3 logo instead of v2

dialogs.title: Authorize EasyPost carrier label purchase
dialogs.visibleWhen: Manager/admin only; quote present and not expired; package verified; EasyPost live purchasing explicitly enabled

fields.name: Package number
fields.meaning: Physical parcel identifier, prevents double purchases.

fields.name: Carrier and service
fields.meaning: Exact selected rate and service, not guaranteed delivery.

fields.name: Purchase authorization checkbox
fields.meaning: Confirms correct address, parcel dimensions, carrier, cost.

dialogs.confirmation: Browser asks to approve a real postage charge for exact price
dialogs.result: Purchases carrier postage once. Does not mark package shipped or send notification.
errors: Purchase outcome uncertain—recover, do not retry
dialogs.trainingScenario: Compare fictional USPS rates without buying any real postage

dialogs.title: Record previously purchased USPS Click-N-Ship label
dialogs.visibleWhen: Manager/admin, release-ready job, package has no purchased EasyPost label

fields.name: USPS tracking number
fields.meaning: Tracking printed on existing purchased USPS postage.

fields.name: USPS receipt / purchase reference
fields.meaning: Reference proving this label was bought through the external USPS account.

fields.name: USPS postage paid
fields.meaning: Optional actual cost; not an automatic purchase.

fields.name: Notes
fields.meaning: Additional audit context.

dialogs.confirmation: Label was actually purchased through USPS website
dialogs.result: Saves external label receipt and blocks second postage for same package
dialogs.trainingScenario: Explain why recording a label is not buying postage or confirming carrier dispatch

dialogs.title: Record independently verified delivery
dialogs.visibleWhen: After actual carrier dispatch and package/QC verification

fields.name: Verification source
fields.meaning: Carrier proof-of-delivery or actual customer confirmation.

fields.name: Actual evidence reference
fields.meaning: Document, carrier event or reply identifier.

fields.name: Verification notes
fields.meaning: Explanation of how confirmation was obtained.

dialogs.confirmation: Delivery was independently verified; printed label alone is not delivery
dialogs.result: Creates immutable delivery evidence; leaves Production Board final job closeout separate
dialogs.trainingScenario: Compare label purchased, carrier dispatched, and delivered events

dialogs.title: Confirm customer email actually sent
dialogs.visibleWhen: Manager/admin; an approved draft exists; related job evidence supports the message type

fields.name: Customer email
fields.meaning: Verified intended recipient, never guessed.

fields.name: Subject and message
fields.meaning: Exact saved draft copied to external mail application.

dialogs.confirmation: The exact email was actually sent externally to this recipient
dialogs.result: Creates an immutable manual-send audit event; does not send email
dialogs.trainingScenario: Draft fictional pickup email, discuss when and how to record real dispatch

dialogs.title: Confirm WooCommerce order status change
dialogs.visibleWhen: Woo-connected production job with authorized action

fields.name: Next status
fields.meaning: Woo order status requested by the actual Production Board action.

dialogs.confirmation: Confirm specified WooCommerce order and new state
dialogs.result: May affect Woo order lifecycle; not a training-only toggle
dialogs.trainingScenario: Review simulated changes; no live status transitions

dialogs.title: Publish client WordPress store after approval
dialogs.visibleWhen: Recurring WooCommerce campaign with approved products, client category, WordPress draft and manager approval

fields.name: Client logo, template, palette
fields.meaning: Visual storefront branding must match approved client identity.

fields.name: Client-specific category
fields.meaning: Controls products visible on the client landing page; not product URL privacy.

fields.name: Ordering and delivery instructions
fields.meaning: Customer-facing instructions, deadlines, pickup or shipping rules.

dialogs.confirmation: Manager verifies customer approval and correct Woo product set before publishing
dialogs.result: Publishes client WordPress page through authenticated server workflow; paid orders still handled in WooCommerce
dialogs.trainingScenario: Create fictional storefront draft only; do not publish a live customer site
